title: 12 Best Sip Iceland-inspired cocktails using local crowberries, angelica, and birch spirits at Reykjavik's cocktail bars.
description: Discover Reykjavik's top cocktail bars crafting unique drinks with local Icelandic ingredients like crowberries, angelica, and birch spirits. Find your perfect sip.

places.name: Apotek Hotel Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Crowberry Elixir' a gin-based cocktail infused with local crowberries and a hint of angelica, perfectly representing Iceland's wild flavors.

places.name: Jungle Cocktail Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their 'Arctic Jungle' cocktail, a bespoke creation that often incorporates Icelandic birch spirit or crowberry syrup into an otherwise tropical profile.

places.name: Slippbarinn
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal menu always features a 'Nordic Sour' variation, frequently highlighting local fruits like crowberries or rhubarb, often paired with an Icelandic gin.

places.name: Petersen Svítan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy their 'Skyr Sour', a creamy, unique take on a whisky sour, often featuring Icelandic skyr and a touch of local berry syrup.

places.name: Ísafold Bistro & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order the 'Birch Old Fashioned', a clever rendition of the classic using an Icelandic birch-aged spirit or a touch of birch syrup to add a unique earthy sweetness.

places.name: Pablo Discobar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their 'Crowberry Margarita', a tangy and refreshing twist on the classic, where the sweetness of crowberries balances perfectly with tequila and lime.

places.name: Míla
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their 'Bartender's Choice' and specify an interest in local Icelandic flavors; they often feature inventive combinations with crowberries, blueberries, or even birch.

places.name: Sour Grapes
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for their 'Rhubarb Spritz', a refreshing and tart cocktail featuring locally sourced Icelandic rhubarb, perfect as an aperitif.

places.name: Bar Ananas
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Volcanic Passion' often gets an Icelandic twist with a crowberry puree or a dash of local herbal liqueur, blending tropical and Nordic flavors.

places.name: Bunk Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Keep an eye on their daily specials board for 'The Nordic Mule' or 'Crowberry Collins', usually featuring local ingredients and a fresh twist.

places.name: BrewDog Reykjavik
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Birch Tree Spritzer' or a 'Mossy Negroni' are good bets, often featuring local spirits or herbal infusions that nod to the Icelandic landscape.

places.name: The Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for an 'Icelandic Gin & Tonic' with a local gin (like Vor gin) and a splash of crowberry syrup for a simple, refreshing local twist.
